subject: How a model measurement card travels mill -> signed -> Merkle-committed, and what feeds which root
resolves_blocker: 2 (mill -> index -> root promotion path: TRACED — the path exists and works)

pipeline.name: mill
pipeline.produces: unsigned card artifacts attached to the workflow run
pipeline.gates: cell flips only when the signed card verifies VALID under the DID and n>=30; ollama: model class skips HF admission

pipeline.name: land (unsigned)
pipeline.gates: signature null, status UNMEASURED, id == sha256(canonical body), <=3KB, brand-gate clean; a (model, axis) cell already carrying a signed card is SKIPPED — one cell, one card
pipeline.human_gate: Never touches master: lands on a BRANCH and opens a PR; a human merge is the gate.

pipeline.name: sign
pipeline.gates: freeze_body() writes the state that survives the signature — status MEASURED at n>=30, UNMEASURED with reason below; signature_state SIGNED. Signs via GitHub OIDC -> Pages /api/board-sign. The PKCS8 never leaves Pages.
pipeline.supersession: re-signing a cell writes a NEW content-addressed file and appends to mill-cards-signed/SUPERSEDED.jsonl (superseded_id -> by_id). Old bytes are never rewritten.

pipeline.name: Merkle commitment (the actual 'in a root' step)
pipeline.leaf_rule: sha256 over canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace, ensure_ascii=False) of the WHOLE signed card — body, id, signature, did — NOT the body alone and NOT the card id
pipeline.excludes: any card listed as superseded_id in SUPERSEDED.jsonl — one live card per (model, axis) cell
pipeline.accounting_check: 1466 leaves + 1402 superseded = 2868 = every signed mill card. No card is lost.
pipeline.docs: scripts/card_root.py module docstring — '2026-09-03 there were 208 signed measurement cards ... and not one of them appeared in any Merkle root' (the gap this closed)

pipeline.name: OTS stamp
pipeline.state: COMMITMENT ONLY. Reads pending until a calendar commits it to a Bitcoin block; STAMPED_PENDING_BITCOIN is a calendar receipt, never Bitcoin-confirmed.

public_root_json.content: notice / RWA / stablecoin / XRPL leaves — NOT model measurement cards

signed_index.note: NOT fed by the mill. The mill never writes this index.

three_roots_are_different_surfaces.rule: Never sum these, never conflate them, never say 'the root' without naming which.

pr1888_correction.previous_claim_by_tui3: PR#1888's 36 cards are STAGED: 0 in index, 0 in root, still after 26 days.
pr1888_correction.corrected: All 36 are SUPERSEDED_EXCLUDED — every one was replaced by a later signed card for the same (model, axis) cell.

evidence.replacements_superseded_again: 2/36 (multi-hop chains, both on the frequently re-measured affect axis)

pr1888_correction.why_it_matters: 'Not in the root' was true of root.json but the WRONG test: measurement cards belong to card-root, not public-root. Their absence from root.json is correct, and their absence from card-root is deliberate supersession, not a stalled promotion.
pr1888_correction.still_true: They are NOT in signed/card_index.json (0/36) — but nothing promotes mill cards into that index; it is a frozen 2026-08-19 historical corpus.

integrity_invariants_verified: 1466 + 1402 = 2868 signed cards — every signed card is either a live leaf or an explicitly named supersession
leaf commits to the WHOLE card, so signature or DID reference cannot be swapped without breaking the root
old signed bytes are never rewritten (content-addressed; write_immutable / supersession ledger)
a card root build is a COMMITMENT, not an anchor: .ots sidecar state governs, file existence does not
remaining_gates_not_traversable_here: Stage 2 human merge of the landing PR (owner)
Stage 5 OTS stamping + Bitcoin confirmation (owner; STAMPED_PENDING_BITCOIN until then)
Promoting mill cards into signed/card_index.json is not part of this pipeline at all — by design, not by omission
